data.note: Hand-written before the CLI exists; the first protocol sample.

data.text: Bootstrap rule: protocol first, CLI second. Each manual step is replaced by a command as it lands.

data.decision: Add test/validate-mission.test.mjs outside T-001's declared file list
data.why: TDD requires a test that failed first and stays runnable; the plan lists no test file for the validator
data.cost_if_wrong: One file beyond the plan's declared scope; easy to move or keep

data.decision: Do not verify mission_created artifact hashes in the validator
data.why: The protocol defines no plan_amended event, so a hard hash check would reject every legitimate future amendment
data.cost_if_wrong: Frozen-artifact drift stays undetected until the protocol defines amendments

data.decision: task_done.data.gates uses {id, exit_code, evidence}; evidence paths resolve relative to the mission directory
data.why: T-002 must record and T-003 must write the same shape; one convention now avoids a split
data.cost_if_wrong: If cairn record chooses another shape, the validator rejects its own output

data.text: Finding: plan.md T-003 makes the missing-gate fixture a severity: block gate, but that fixture must exit non-zero, so the gate can never pass. Fix before T-003 with --expect-invalid or an assertion wrapper. Also: task_done.head names the work commit, so its ledger event lands in the next commit; invariant 3 cannot hold for a self-referential head. Decide the convention before T-005.

data.decision: The human delegated the bootstrap ledger write to the zcode adapter for T-001; events carry actor zcode
data.why: Explicit instruction: write the ledger, actor zcode. cairn record does not exist yet
data.cost_if_wrong: The human-writer bootstrap rule is waived for this tick and the first task_done is agent-written; the ledger shows exactly who wrote what

data.decision: Amend the protocol, mission, policy, and plan to make the goal explicit and add drift controls
data.why: The human confirmed that the project is the method and Cairn is its first artifact, and asked that the positioning and every drift factor be recorded and guarded. mission_amended is not implemented until T-002, so this amendment is recorded as a ruling with old and new hashes.
data.cost_if_wrong: The frozen target artifacts change before mission end; a reconcile that trusts only mission_created reports drift until T-002 implements mission_amended.

data.decision: Add T-006 (goal guard and session audit) and make T-002 depend on it
data.why: The human identified that goal alignment was enforced only by conversation and asked for automation plus self-observation. T-006 adds goal-check, session audit, a project skill, and a SessionStart hook; it stays inside A5/A7.
data.cost_if_wrong: The plan gains a task before T-002; if the guard is wrong, T-002 waits one tick.

data.decision: Write the T-006 ledger events as zcode under the existing bootstrap delegation
data.why: cairn record does not exist yet; the human asked for this task and previously delegated the bootstrap ledger write to zcode
data.cost_if_wrong: The second agent-written completion; the ledger shows actor zcode and this ruling

data.text: Session audit at T-006: 9 alignment corrections, 0 completion claims without a gate, 8 writes outside the plan (the recorded docs amendment), 6 confirmation requests; verdict drift; evidence/T-006/audit.json. The audit is diagnostic, not a gate.

T-002 done-when proof: node src/cli.ts record T-002 --status done exited 2 with "refused: T-002: no blocking gate at exit 0 recorded"; evidence/T-002/refusal.json. The refusal did not write the ledger.

data.decision: T-002 adds its tests, a test helper, the mission_amended validator check, the pnpm lockfile, and the inbox resolution outside its declared file list; the T-002 completion is written by zcode under the bootstrap delegation
data.why: TDD needs runnable tests that do not encode the live ledger state; appendEvent must accept mission_amended and the validator must not reject it; pnpm install writes a lockfile; the toolchain decision closes inbox item 4; cairn record cannot record the task that implements it because T-002 has no gate evidence at implementation time
data.cost_if_wrong: Eight paths beyond the plan declared files; each is required by T-002 interfaces, its tests, the toolchain, or the decision log. The completion is agent-written under the same delegation as T-001 and T-006.

findings: Coverage: A1, A2, A6, A7 proven; A5 and A8 advanced but unproven; A3 and A4 untouched; no criterion is unreachable within T-003..T-005.

Non-goals: T-006 added .zcode hook/skill glue; the plan amendment ruling of 2026-10-30T20:13:52.390Z covers it and docs/automation.md keeps the contract harness-neutral. No human-approved non-goal waiver exists; resolve the wording collision explicitly at the next amendment.
Cold start: the repo alone names T-003, serves A3, gates test and fixture. mission.md Current action still says T-002 and plan.md statuses are advisory; fix by amendment.
A8 unproven: appendEvent and the validator accept mission_amended, but no live mission_amended event exists. The next target-artifact edit should be the first live event.

T-002 completion was hand-appended by zcode after cairn record shipped, because record requires gate evidence that only cairn verify (T-003) can produce. AGENTS.md bootstrap expiry said no manual append after T-002; the written expiry is inconsistent with what happened. Clarified to end at T-003.

Invariant 3: all three task_done heads name the work commit and the event lands in the next commit; inbox item 3 documents the convention but docs/protocol.md is unchanged. Protocol change needs human approval before T-005.
Minor: the mission validator does not check serves; goal-check does. T-003 fixture gate currently exits 2 until --expect-invalid lands.
T-006 audit evidence reports drift with 8 unplanned writes; they map to recorded amendments and non-target docs, with no unrecorded target change.

data.why: T-003 produces verifyTask, but the plan listed no CLI entry point; cairn verify is what T-005 consumes and what the A3 next -> dispatch -> verify -> record loop runs. T-003 also tightens record to require every blocking gate, per the gate contract. Both changes are inside the existing acceptance envelope.

Current action cached a ledger-derived next task and had gone stale (it still named T-002). It now points at the ledger instead, so a cold session cannot misread the step. No goal, non-goal, acceptance criterion, task, or gate changed.

data.decision: The mission.md Current action edit is an operational pointer, not a goal, non-goal, acceptance, or protocol change, so cairn may approve it; a human may still veto it at the next checkpoint.
data.why: The paragraph duplicated state that the ledger owns and had already gone stale, which the milestone audit flagged as cold-start hygiene. Leaving it stale risks a fresh session starting a completed task.
data.cost_if_wrong: If a human reads the target freeze as covering every byte of mission.md, this is an agent-approved target edit. The mission_amended event names both hashes, and reverting it is a second amendment.

data.why: T-004 adds docs/adapter.md, a new human-facing document. The bilingual policy requires a Chinese companion and a status row in docs/i18n.md in the same change. Neither path was in T-004 files.
The dispatch brief must carry forbidden commands; buildPacket dropped them. Adding forbidden_commands to the packet and its type needs src/plan.ts, which T-004 files omitted.

A4 names a state that reconcile explains, but cairn reconcile does not exist; T-005 also needs a test gate for it, and docs/self-hosting.md needs a Chinese companion and an i18n row under the bilingual policy.

Reconcile checks evidence paths that verify already knows how to validate. Exporting isEvidenceFile from src/verify.ts avoids a second, drifting copy of the path-safety rule. T-005 files omitted src/verify.ts.
